name: Sapo National Park
story: Sapo National Park is located in Sinoe County, Liberia, and covers an area of 1,804 square kilometers. It is the country's largest protected area of rainforest and contains the second-largest area of primary tropical rainforest in West Africa. The park is home to wildlife including the African forest elephant and the pygmy hippopotamus.
matters: The park is located in the Upper Guinean forest ecosystem, which is a biodiversity hotspot. This ecosystem contains the highest mammal species diversity of any region in the world.
